notes:
ADVERSARIAL READ vs /images/blueprints/factory/81163ff25606__3200__Double_besom.jpg.

WHAT THE DRAWING SPECIFIES: a trouser BACK — waistband with belt loops, centre-back seam, and two red horizontal pocket marks, one per side, each with a short vertical dart line running up from the pocket's inner end to the waistband. No flap symbol and no button symbol on either.

VERIFIED AT 3x ZOOM: each pocket is unmistakably a DOUBLE besom — two separate narrow welts, upper and lower, of equal depth, meeting along the centre of the opening, both crisply pressed. This was the one thing worth measuring rather than eyeballing, because the neighbouring option on the same field ('Left Welt with Button') is a SINGLE welt, and a single-welt render would have been a Critical substitution. It is not single.

ATTEMPTED REJECTIONS THAT FAILED:
(1) Single welt borrowed from the sibling option? No — two welts, confirmed at zoom.
(2) A button or buttonhole on either pocket, which would make it the welt-with-button sibling? No — neither pocket carries a button, buttonhole or tab.
(3) A flap tucked inside or above the opening? No — the openings are clean jetted slits with nothing hanging over them.
(4) One pocket only, which would make it a left- or right-side option? No — two pockets, both fully in frame, level and symmetric.
(5) Darts missing? No — a vertical dart seam runs from the waistband down to the inner end of each pocket, as drawn.
(6) Wrong face — trouser front standing in for the back? No: centre-back seam present, no fly, no front crease at the top, belt loops positioned as on a back view. This is the back.
(7) Annotation traced? No red, no numbers, no arrows anywhere.

No critical or major findings.
